$Comment: Be on the server for several Hallow's Eves. CALENDAR_ATTENDED fires once per player for each
year's run of the event, so each season adds one, and the criterion's Amount is how many it takes.
It has no Parent, so it is one achievement kept across the years rather than a yearly copy, and
it carries no hallowed tag, so The Hallowed never waits on it. The description's number comes
from the Amount through @amount. The criterion's TextKey words the step, since the shared
sentence names the event by its raw id.
